    return factorial(n) // factorial(n - k)

def main_program():
    total_n, modulus = map(int, input_line().split())
    if total_n == 1:
        print(0)
        return
    sequence = [1]
    total_value = 0
    for i in range(2, total_n + 1):
        size = ((i - 1) * i) // 2 + 1
        new_sequence = [0] * size
        cum_sum = [0] * (len(sequence) + 1)
        for index in range(len(sequence) - 1, -1, -1):
            cum_sum[index] = (cum_sum[index + 1] + sequence[index]) % modulus

            left_bound = max(0, w + 1 - i)
            right_bound = min(len(sequence) - 1, w)
            new_sequence[w] = cum_sum[left_bound] - cum_sum[right_bound + 1]
        e_array = [0] * (len(cum_sum))
        f_array = [0] * (len(cum_sum))
        for w in range(len(cum_sum) - 1):
            e_array[w + 1] = (e_array[w] + cum_sum[w]) % modulus
            f_array[w + 1] = (f_array[w] - w * cum_sum[w]) % modulus
        R_idx = len(sequence)
        temp_b_value = 0
        for jj in range(max(0, len(sequence) - i), len(sequence) - 1):
            L_idx = jj + 2
            temp_b_value += (((e_array[R_idx] - e_array[L_idx]) * (i + 1 + jj) + (f_array[R_idx] - f_array[L_idx])) * sequence[jj]) % modulus
        for jj in range(len(sequence) - i):
            L_idx = jj + 2
            R_idx = i + jj
            temp_b_value += (((e_array[R_idx + 1] - e_array[L_idx]) * (i + 1 + jj) + (f_array[R_idx + 1] - f_array[L_idx])) * sequence[jj]) % modulus
        total_value += (temp_b_value * calc_perm(total_n, total_n - i)) % modulus
        sequence = new_sequence
    print(total_value % modulus)
